description:
FILED s536j (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08), found when the full gate on a `git archive` extraction under the worktree's scratch/ read FAIL on Pl/t/pcl-runtime-env-01.t row 1.  PRE-EXISTING: the 3139fcb0 extraction at scratch/s536j/base fails the same row; the worktree itself (a git checkout) passes.

    cl/pcl-runtime.lisp %p-version-from-git runs `git -C ROOT describe --tags --always` with no test for ROOT/.git, so git walks up to any ENCLOSING repository.
    pcl (the script) pcl_version tests `-d "$ROOT/.git" || -f "$ROOT/.git"` first.
    Tree extracted inside another repository:   ./pcl --version -> "unknown (no VERSION file, and not a git checkout)"
                                                $ENV{_PCL_RUNTIME_} -> "v0.1.0-2776-gd0fd8e7e (git checkout)" (the ENCLOSING repo's describe)

Both comments say "SAME SOURCE".  The runtime half is the wrong one: an unpacked PCL tarball under someone's git-managed home directory reports that repo's describe as PCL's version.  FIX SHAPE: the same .git test in %p-version-from-git (`probe-file` on ROOT/.git, file or directory).  Row: Pl/t/pcl-runtime-env-01.t row 1 run from a nested extraction.  Not fixed here: `cl/` is outside batch s536j's region and the fault is not its own.  Measurement note for agents: until this is fixed, run a gate on an extraction OUTSIDE any git tree (scratch/s536j/gate2.sh does).


=== s536j (s538): BOTH placements fail -- the outside-git measurement note above was WRONG ===
Measured 2026-11-11: an extraction OUTSIDE any git tree fails the same row too, with the OTHER mismatch: `$ENV{_PCL_RUNTIME_}` = "unknown" (the runtime's %p-pcl-version fallback) vs `pcl --version` = "unknown (no VERSION file, and not a git checkout)" (pcl_version()'s).  Main 301e4af9 (code 4a39a1c7) extracted to ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s536j-gate/x-main: `prove -v Pl/t/pcl-runtime-env-01.t` -> not ok 1, got 'unknown' (scratch/s536j/envrow.log); s536j's gate2.sh on its own extraction the same (gate-final.log, 369 files / 12,009 rows, that row the only failure).  So the fix is TWO lines of one function, not one: %p-version-from-git must test ROOT/.git (file or directory) before it spawns git, AND %p-pcl-version's last resort must be pcl's string "unknown (no VERSION file, and not a git checkout)" -- or both read ONE definition.  Until then a gate on a `git archive` extraction cannot read PASS in any placement: take the full gate in a git checkout (the worktree), as main's gate is taken.
subject: $ENV{_PCL_RUNTIME_} and `pcl --version` disagree in a tree with no .git of its own nested inside a git tree: the runtime's `git describe` walks up, `pcl` tests $ROOT/.git
